title: nnnotes.cost/1
description: The measured cost of a task's last run (not deterministic).

cpuSeconds.description: CPU seconds of the task's process and of its child processes.

peakRssBytes.description: Peak resident memory of the task's process during the task; null where the platform does not report it.

startRssBytes.description: Resident memory of the task's process when the task started (imports, and what earlier tasks of a worker left); null where the platform does not report it.

childCpuSeconds.description: CPU seconds of the child processes the task ran (external tools), included in cpuSeconds; null where the platform does not report them.
